items.html: *ZA had at first VAK, and afterwards was completed into ten complete Sefirot, in this manner: for behold, the right line is Chesed and Netzach, and in them are six articles; and then the two upper articles of Chesed join with the upper article of the Netzach of Ima, and behold, Chokhma of three articles, a complete measure. And likewise in the left line, the two upper articles of Gevura join with the upper article of the Hod of Ima. And in this same manner in the middle line.
